mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may potentiate corticosteroid effects and increase immunosuppression risk; both agents have anti-inflammatory properties that may compound effects on immune function and gastrointestinal mucosal protection.
action: Monitor for enhanced corticosteroid adverse effects (infection risk, GI ulceration, hyperglycemia); consider spacing administration and educate patient on infection signs; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is warranted.
